purpose: Authorize an additive red-test amendment that closes the frozen method specification's fallback-contract gaps before any production implementation.

supersedes_for_next_decision.reason: Static coverage audit found missing mandatory fallback red contracts.

bound_frozen_baseline.preservation: All v0.1 frozen bytes remain immutable and authoritative; the amendment is additive and versioned separately.

A.meaning: Authorize preparation of new versioned fallback fixtures and red tests only.

T.meaning: Authorize running only the new and existing deterministic contract tests to record the expected pre-implementation red state; no test may be made green.

P.meaning: Do not edit or replace the accepted v0.1 snapshot; produce a separately hash-bound additive amendment and a new freeze candidate.

C.meaning: Keep src/alg1_replan absent and do not populate implementation dependencies.

E.meaning: Keep optimizer loops, pilots, benchmarks and formal phases disabled.

F.meaning: No objective or constraint evaluation and no formal FFE may occur.

required_new_red_contracts: a disjoint consecutive topology returns UNSTABLE_GRAPH rather than merely Jaccard zero
a noncomplete connected graph returns SINGLE_COMMUNITY
a valid graph without a prior reference returns NO_STABILITY_REFERENCE
a graph-active target with no reciprocal valid pair returns NO_VALID_PAIR
every donor-selection fallback path preserves parent SHADE donor IDs and base_rng continuation under the same run seed
permitted_execution: Run deterministic pytest collection/execution for the frozen and additive contract files only to record the expected red state.
Perform static syntax, JSON-schema and hash checks that do not import or create production implementation.
scope_if_authorized.expected_red_root_cause: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'alg1_replan' because production implementation remains prohibited.

hard_stop_conditions: Any edit to a frozen v0.1 file or snapshot.
Any change to method equations, thresholds, seeds, endpoints, budgets, statistical families or kill criteria.
Any production source file creation, dependency installation, optimizer loop, benchmark call or objective/constraint evaluation.
Any additive test unexpectedly passes because an unrecorded production package exists; stop and inventory the state before proceeding.
Any attempt to interpret red-test behavior as performance, novelty or scientific-result evidence.
next_gate_if_authorized_and_completed: Generate and verify a new additive freeze candidate v0.2, then stop for a new author hash confirmation before revising the implementation authorization candidate.
suggested_response: 我确认I3 TDD覆盖修订授权候选v0.1，SHA-256为<CANDIDATE_SHA256>；A=AUTHORIZE_ADDITIVE_RED_TEST_AMENDMENT；T=AUTHORIZE_AMENDMENT_RED_PHASE_ONLY；P=PRESERVE_FROZEN_PLAN_V0_1；C=DO_NOT_AUTHORIZE_PRODUCTION_IMPLEMENTATION；E=DO_NOT_AUTHORIZE_OPTIMIZER_EXECUTION；F=KEEP_FORMAL_FFE_ZERO
